prestations.note_porte_p1: For a personal or family project, the architect leads the 7 phases below. The surveyor steps in at site staking and final as-built survey. The engineering office is only required for reinforced concrete structures.
prestations.note_porte_p2: For a real-estate development or private facility, the three trades coordinate from the schematic design phase onwards. Construction documents (DCE) and site supervision are systematically delegated to an engineering office and a surveyor.
prestations.note_porte_p3: Under delegated project management, you benefit from the architect's 7 phases + the surveyor's 3 tasks + the engineer's 3 technical lots, all coordinated and contracted by CITURBAREA.
prestations.archi.phase_1.title: Schematic sketch (Esquisse)
prestations.archi.phase_1.deliv_1: Volumetric sketches and preliminary site plans
prestations.archi.phase_1.deliv_2: Validation of the architectural concept with the client
prestations.archi.phase_2.title: Schematic Design (APS)
prestations.archi.phase_2.deliv_1: Floor plans, elevations and sections at 1/200 scale
prestations.archi.phase_2.deliv_2: Descriptive note and preliminary budget estimate
prestations.archi.phase_3.title: Design Development (APD)
prestations.archi.phase_3.deliv_2: Structural pre-sizing to validate the reinforced concrete design
prestations.archi.phase_3.note: The APD is the critical milestone that grounds the reinforced concrete plan. Structural constraints must be integrated before any building permit commitment.
prestations.archi.phase_4.title: Permit drawings / Building permit
prestations.archi.phase_4.deliv_1: Complete regulatory filing (drawings, design statement, forms)
prestations.archi.phase_4.deliv_2: One-stop-shop submission and review follow-up until permit issuance
prestations.archi.phase_5.title: Construction Documents (DCE)
prestations.archi.phase_5.deliv_1: Construction drawings for technical packages (structure, MEP, electrical) in coordination with the engineering office
prestations.archi.phase_5.deliv_2: Construction drawings for secondary packages (finishes, aluminum/wood joinery, suspended ceiling, paint)
prestations.archi.phase_5.note: Construction documents require a prior geotechnical report carried out by excavator with at least 3 tests: mechanical soil, hydraulic, and groundwater level.
prestations.archi.phase_6.title: Special Specifications Book (CPS)
prestations.archi.phase_6.deliv_1: Detailed technical specification by trade package
prestations.archi.phase_6.deliv_2: Quantity take-off serving as the tender basis
prestations.archi.phase_6.note: The CPS is jointly drafted with the engineering office for the technical packages.
prestations.archi.phase_7.title: Construction supervision
prestations.archi.phase_7.deliv_2: Validation of technical choices and trade-offs during construction
prestations.archi.phase_7.pv.title: Detailed acceptance minutes (PV cadence)
prestations.archi.phase_7.pv.plancher: One acceptance minute per slab and foundation acceptance
prestations.archi.phase_7.pv.maconnerie: One masonry acceptance minute per floor
prestations.archi.phase_7.pv.isolation: One thermal and acoustic insulation acceptance minute per floor
prestations.archi.phase_7.pv.echantillon: One sample validation minute per secondary package (wood/aluminum joinery, flooring, tiling, suspended ceiling, paint)
prestations.archi.phase_7.pv.reception_s: One acceptance minute for secondary packages post-completion
prestations.archi.phase_7.pv.metre: One as-built survey and quantity minute post-works (recommended for the registration file)
prestations.topo.task_1.title: Site staking at project start
prestations.topo.task_1.deliv_1: Adversarial site boundary marking and benchmark installation
prestations.topo.task_2.title: Structural axes acceptance
prestations.topo.task_3.title: As-built survey after works
prestations.topo.task_3.deliv_1: Final topographic survey of the completed structure
prestations.topo.task_3.deliv_2: Enforceable document for the registration and compliance file
prestations.be.lot_1.title: Reinforced concrete and rebar plans
prestations.be.lot_1.deliv_1: Structural calculations based on the geotechnical report
prestations.be.lot_2.title: MEP plumbing plans
prestations.be.lot_3.title: Electrical plans — main LV switchboard and low-voltage systems
prestations.be.lot_3.deliv_1: Main low-voltage switchboard (TGBT), main distribution and sub-panels
prestations.be.lot_3.deliv_2: Low-voltage systems (data network, CCTV, access control) coordinated with the architect's plans
